ignored_as_data.text: Chipz nikikureetera okuteeramu sente omu byamaguzi bya miringo mingi n’esente za buri izooba n’enteekateeka y’okweta ey’emirengo 3.
Ebi osiingwire nibigyenda butunu omu nsaho yaawe.
Ekisumuruzo kyaawe ky'okushuubura n'enamba 6 ezi orikukozesa okuhamya okwihamu sente n'ebindi ebikuru.
Ekisumuruzo kyaawe ky'okutaaha nikikozesibwa kutaaha omu akaunti yaawe ya Chipz.
Enamba ya esimu ishemereire kutandika na 0 kandi kuba ya namba 10
Gabana orunyiriri rwaawe, okore obugaiga bwaawe, otebeekanise amagara gaawe.
Giteere aha simu yaawe obaase kugihikaho juba, kandi ogyigure butunu kuruga aha karatasi kaawe ak'okubanza.
Ku kutaribaho kintu, porogaraamu yaateirweho — gyigyure aha ndabiro yaawe. Aha iPhone, kozesa Share reero “Add to Home Screen”.
Obwire bw’okwihamu sente: 6:00 AM kuhika 5:00 PM.
Okuzengurutsa rumwe okw'obusa buri izooba, nikugarukamu aha kiro.
Okwihamu rumwe — ku kushashwirwe nobaasa kushaba okundi. Kuhika aha 1 aha izooba.
Omuringo ogurikukira obumanzi muri Uganda kukuza sente zaawe
Otakozesa akaunti ya ira okuta sente.
Sente ku zitarikuhika, otukirire obuhwezi aha TG.
Sente z’okwihamu zishemereire kuba hagati ya 20,000 na 1,000,000.
Tihakwetengyesa koodi hati — oine omu b'okubanza kwegaitaho.
Tihariho kuzengurutsa kusigaire. Okuzengurutsa kwaawe kw'obusa nikwija aha kiro.
Tihariho nteekateeka erikukora. Kanda Kihikire kureeba ezo ezahwire.
Tunga sente buri izooba oyeta abantu kuteeramu sente.
Yeta abanywani baawe. Notunga sente ku barikugura ekyamaguzi kyabo eky'okubanza.
Yoleka omurundi gumwe buri izooba (nikugarukamu aha kiro) kurindira orukurato rwaawe kandi otunge UGX 500 buri murundi.
